# DebBuilder

> DebBuilder is a self-hosted visual workflow builder for AI agents, voice agents and automations: n8n-style
> editor, LangGraph execution engine, LangChain AI nodes, LiveKit voice agents and 200+ integrations.
> The editor and API require signing in; each user sees only their own workflows and credentials.

## API

- [OpenAPI schema](/openapi.json): every REST endpoint (workflows, executions, credentials, voice, webhooks)
- [API reference](/docs): interactive documentation of the same endpoints
- [Health](/api/health): liveness probe (no sign-in)

## Triggering workflows

- Production webhooks: `POST /webhook/<path>` of an active workflow with a Webhook trigger
- Hosted forms: `/form/<workflow id>` for workflows with a Form trigger
- Chat: `POST /api/chat/<workflow id>` for workflows with a Chat trigger (if the trigger allows public access)
